caption:
Sure you're not qualified enough? A hand already took hold of you. (Amos 7:15 devotional)

Authority never rose from your background — it flows from the One who sends. You carry it not because you're strong, but because One carries it with you.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Do I keep proving I'm qualified — instead of trusting the One who called me?
